acceptance: A tracked versioned inventory deterministically identifies each founding public donor/reference source by canonical repository plus exact revision, records SPDX expression and license snapshot path/digest, and rejects unknown or duplicate fields/identities.

Exact upstream license snapshots for Orca, AgentQL, and Desktop Commander are preserved from the pinned planning revisions and their recorded SHA-256 digests verify byte-for-byte in repository validation.

Notice validation fails closed on malformed/non-UTF8/oversized inventory data, symlink or unsafe evidence paths, missing license files, digest mismatch, duplicate source identity, and provenance records lacking a matching notice entry/license evidence relationship.

A canonical donor import checklist makes provenance, notices, dependency/assets review, characterization, applicable security review, branding/service cleanup, and exact import/adaptation history explicit pre-merge requirements.
The existing Provenance CI job runs notice tests, notice inventory validation, and provenance validation from full history; all existing CI jobs remain green.
The exact implementation receives Diffcipline R2 PASS plus OpenCodeReview review on all supported changed files, imports zero donor product source, and post-merge main preserves all required gates.

minimality.rationale: Reuse the existing provenance enforcement model and Python 3.11 standard library; add no package/runtime dependency and keep notice validation separate from product code.

requirements: Never execute third-party license/inventory content or follow symlinks while validating evidence.
Fail closed when source identity, exact revision, license evidence, digest, or provenance-to-notice linkage is ambiguous or missing.
Do not represent founder permission as changing embedded dependency, asset, trademark, model-weight, or hosted-service obligations.

outcome: Kernux has a deterministic third-party license/notice inventory with preserved founding-donor license evidence, machine validation tied to provenance records, and an executable donor import checklist before any donor source is admitted.
rationale: The provenance manifest gate is proven, but donor import still needs preserved upstream license evidence, a canonical notice inventory, and a repeatable import checklist so source reuse cannot outpace legal/provenance review.

risk.recovery: Revert the bounded notice-inventory/checklist changes; no donor product source or user/product runtime state is introduced by this task.

scope_in: Create a versioned machine-readable third-party notice/license inventory for source material stored in Kernux or explicitly prepared for donor import.

Preserve exact upstream license evidence for the currently identified public founding-donor sources at their pinned planning revisions: stablyai/orca, tinyfish-io/agentql, and wonderwhy-er/DesktopCommanderMCP.

Implement dependency-free validation for inventory structure, canonical source identity/revision, unique entries, safe repository-relative evidence paths, license snapshot digests, symlink/file integrity, and deterministic diagnostics.
Cross-check tracked donor provenance manifests against the notice inventory so a prepared/imported donor record cannot exist without matching source identity and preserved license evidence.

Add a canonical donor import checklist covering authorization, exact source pin, license/notice evidence, dependency/asset obligations, provenance mapping, characterization, security review where applicable, branding/service removal, mechanical import history, and post-import verification.
Run notice validation inside the existing Provenance CI job and document the enforcement workflow.
scope_out: No Orca, TinyFish, AgentQL, Desktop Commander, or other donor product source import.
No decision or application of the Kernux project license; KX-P00-S01-T04 remains separate.
No legal compatibility conclusion for future Kernux distribution, no SBOM/release NOTICE generation, and no dependency-license scanner; those remain later tasks.
No invented license or authorization record for non-public TinyFish source; any private source must receive its own exact artifact/revision and evidence before import.
title: KX-P00-S04-T02 — Establish third-party notice inventory and donor import checklist
